scripts.build:web: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg-web --out-name kicad_core --release --no-pack -- --features wasm && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('pkg-web/.gitignore',{force:true})"
scripts.build:node: wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node --out-name kicad_core --release --no-pack -- --features wasm && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('pkg-node/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}));require('fs').rmSync('pkg-node/.gitignore',{force:true})"
